answer: Each identity must store a unique 20 GB shard, generated from its key and tagged jade, lotus, or zephyr by epoch. Every hour a random sector is challenged and must be returned within 5 seconds; regenerating a deleted shard takes 3 hours, so it cannot be faked on demand. Running 1,000 Sybils therefore needs 20 TB of always-online disk, about $3,000 in drives plus power, with a separate shard per fake and no sharing.
